-- Sub-areas --------------------------------------------------------------
-- A sub-area is the part of an area you can walk around in without -- crossing an exit marked as a boundary ('amap boundary'), like a palace -- inside a city: drawn on its own, at its own scale. Its name ('amap -- subarea <name>') is kept on whichever of its rooms it was given in. local function SubAreaRooms(startId) local incoming = {} for fromId, cmds in pairs(links) do for _, link in pairs(cmds) do if not link.boundary then incoming[link.to] = incoming[link.to] or {} incoming[link.to][#incoming[link.to] + 1] = fromId end end end local seen, list = { [startId] = true }, { startId } local head = 1 while list[head] do local id = list[head] head = head + 1 local near = {} for _, link in pairs(links[id] or {}) do if not link.boundary then near[#near + 1] = link.to end end for _, from in ipairs(incoming[id] or {}) do near[#near + 1] = from end for _, other in ipairs(near) do if rooms[other] and not seen[other] and not IsOverland(rooms[other]) then seen[other] = true list[#list + 1] = other end end end return list, seen end
-- The name of the sub-area a room is in (nil if it has none). local function SubAreaName(roomId) local list = SubAreaRooms(roomId) table.sort(list) for _, id in ipairs(list) do if rooms[id].subarea then return rooms[id].subarea, id end end return nil end
local function ExitLabel(room, cmd) local link = links[room.id] and links[room.id][cmd] local label = DIRS[cmd] and DIRS[cmd].long or cmd if room.doors[cmd] ~= nil then label = label .. (room.doors[cmd] and " (closed door)" or " (open door)") end if link and link.hidden then label = label .. " (hidden)" end if link and link.boundary then label = label .. " (into " .. (SubAreaName(link.to) or "another part") .. ")" end if not link then label = label .. " (unexplored)" end return label end
local function RoomExitLabels(room) local seen, labels = {}, {} local order = {} for _, d in ipairs(PLANAR) do order[#order + 1] = d end order[#order + 1] = "u" order[#order + 1] = "d" for _, d in ipairs(order) do if room.exits[d] or (links[room.id] and links[room.id][d]) then labels[#labels + 1] = ExitLabel(room, d) seen[d] = true end end local others = {} for e in pairs(room.exits) do if not seen[e] then others[#others + 1] = e; seen[e] = true end end for cmd in pairs(links[room.id] or {}) do if not seen[cmd] then others[#others + 1] = cmd; seen[cmd] = true end end table.sort(others) for _, e in ipairs(others) do labels[#labels + 1] = ExitLabel(room, e) end return labels end
local function RoomTooltip(room) local title = room.name or (room.dark and "(dark room)") or "(name not seen yet)" local parts = { title .. " [#" .. room.id .. ", square " .. SquareLabel(room.sx, room.sy) .. "]" } if room.desc then local d = room.desc if #d > 160 then d = d:sub(1, 157) .. "..." end parts[#parts + 1] = d end parts[#parts + 1] = "Exits: " .. table.concat(RoomExitLabels(room), ", ") if room.noexits and next(room.noexits) then local walls = {} for _, d in ipairs({ "n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w", "nw", "u", "d" }) do if room.noexits[d] then walls[#walls + 1] = DIRS[d].long end end parts[#parts + 1] = "No exit: " .. table.concat(walls, ", ") end if room.note then parts[#parts + 1] = "Note: " .. room.note end return table.concat(parts, "\n") end
local function HasSpecialExit(room) for cmd, link in pairs(links[room.id] or {}) do if link.hidden or not DIRS[cmd] then return true end end for e in pairs(room.exits) do if not DIRS[e] then return true end end return false end
local function StatusText() local where = "square " .. SquareLabel(square.x, square.y) if current and rooms[current] then local room = rooms[current] return where .. " " .. (room.name or (room.dark and "a dark room") or ("room #" .. room.id)) .. (IsOverland(room) and " (overland)" or "") .. (IsIrregular(square.x, square.y) and " (irregular)" or "") .. (SubAreaName(room.id) and (" [" .. SubAreaName(room.id) .. "]") or "") elseif lostCount > 0 then return where .. " LOST (" .. lostCount .. " rooms look alike)" end return where .. " position unknown" end
-- The FORGET button, top right on the status line. Shared by drawing and -- hotspots so the two can't drift apart. local FORGET_LABEL = "FORGET" local function ForgetButtonRect(contentW) local win = mapWin.win local lineH = WindowFontInfo(win, FONT_ID, 1) or 12 local w = (WindowTextWidth(win, FONT_ID, FORGET_LABEL, false) or 40) + 12 local top = mapWin:contentTop() + 1 local r = contentW - EDGE_INSET - 2 return { l = r - w, t = top, r = r, b = top + lineH + 2 } end
local function DrawForgetButton(contentW) local win = mapWin.win local rect = ForgetButtonRect(contentW) WindowRectOp(win, 2, rect.l, rect.t, rect.r, rect.b, BUTTON_BG, 0) WindowRectOp(win, 1, rect.l, rect.t, rect.r, rect.b, BUTTON_BORDER, 0) local tw = WindowTextWidth(win, FONT_ID, FORGET_LABEL, false) or 0 WindowText(win, FONT_ID, FORGET_LABEL, rect.l + math.floor((rect.r - rect.l - tw) / 2), rect.t + 1, rect.r, rect.b, BUTTON_TEXT, false) return rect end
-- The unusual ways out of a room, for the line under the map: commands -- used from it (enter ring, jump down), compass exits it doesn't list, -- exits into another sub-area, and listed exits that aren't compass -- directions but haven't been tried yet. local function SpecialExits(room) local list = {} for cmd, link in pairs(links[room.id] or {}) do if not DIRS[cmd] or link.hidden or link.boundary then local to = rooms[link.to] local where = to and (to.name or (to.dark and "a dark room") or ("room #" .. to.id)) or "?" if link.boundary then where = where .. " [" .. (SubAreaName(link.to) or "another part") .. "]" end list[#list + 1] = { cmd = cmd, text = cmd .. " -> " .. where } end end for e in pairs(room.exits) do if not DIRS[e] and not (links[room.id] and links[room.id][e]) then list[#list + 1] = { cmd = e, text = e .. " (not explored)" } end end table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.cmd < b.cmd end) return list end
local MAX_SPECIAL_LINES = 5
local function DrawMap(contentW, contentH) local win = mapWin.win local top = mapWin:contentTop() local lineH = WindowFontInfo(win, FONT_ID, 1) or 12 drawn = nil
local button = DrawForgetButton(contentW) local statusColour = (not current and lostCount > 0) and LOST_COLOUR or TEXT_COLOUR WindowText(win, FONT_ID, StatusText(), 4, top + 2, button.l - 4, top + 2 + lineH, statusColour, false)
local centerId = current or lastKnown local center = centerId and rooms[centerId] if not center then WindowText(win, FONT_ID, "No room here mapped yet -- walk around or 'look'.", 4, top + 4 + lineH, contentW - 4, top + 4 + 2 * lineH, TEXT_COLOUR, false) return end
-- Unusual exits from the room you're in are listed under the map, one per -- line; clicking one sends its command (see AddHotspots). local specials = (current and rooms[current]) and SpecialExits(rooms[current]) or {} local shown = {} for i = 1, math.min(#specials, MAX_SPECIAL_LINES) do shown[i] = specials[i] end if #specials > MAX_SPECIAL_LINES then shown[MAX_SPECIAL_LINES] = { text = "... " .. (#specials - MAX_SPECIAL_LINES + 1) .. " more (hover a room for all exits)" } end local areaBottom = top + contentH local specialRects = {} if #shown > 0 then areaBottom = top + contentH - #shown * lineH - 6 WindowLine(win, 4, areaBottom + 1, contentW - 4, areaBottom + 1, UNEXPLORED_COLOUR, PEN_SOLID, 1) for i, item in ipairs(shown) do local t = areaBottom + 3 + (i - 1) * lineH local w = WindowText(win, FONT_ID, item.text, 4, t, contentW - EDGE_INSET, t + lineH, HIDDEN_COLOUR, false) or 0 if item.cmd then specialRects[#specialRects + 1] = { cmd = item.cmd, l = 4, t = t, r = math.min(4 + w, contentW - EDGE_INSET), b = t + lineH } end end end
local areaTop = top + lineH + 4 local areaH = areaBottom - areaTop if panFor ~= centerId then panX, panY, panFor = 0, 0, centerId end local cx = math.floor(contentW / 2) + panX local cy = areaTop + math.floor(areaH / 2) + panY local radius = math.ceil(math.max(contentW, areaH) / CELL / 2) + 1 + math.ceil(math.max(math.abs(panX), math.abs(panY)) / CELL) local pos = IsIrregular(center.sx, center.sy) and LayoutIrregular(centerId) or Layout(centerId, radius, true)
local function inside(x, y) return x >= 0 and x <= contentW and y >= areaTop and y <= areaBottom end -- The part of a line inside the map area (nil if none), so an exit to a -- room off the edge still shows, running off toward it. local function clip(x1, y1, x2, y2) local t0, t1 = 0, 1 local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1 for _, edge in ipairs({ { -dx, x1 }, { dx, contentW - x1 }, { -dy, y1 - areaTop }, { dy, areaBottom - y1 } }) do local p, q = edge[1], edge[2] if p == 0 then if q < 0 then return nil end else local t = q / p if p < 0 then if t > t1 then return nil end if t > t0 then t0 = t end else if t < t0 then return nil end if t < t1 then t1 = t end end end end return x1 + t0 * dx, y1 + t0 * dy, x1 + t1 * dx, y1 + t1 * dy end local function screen(p) return cx + p[1] * CELL, cy + p[2] * CELL end
-- Exits first, so boxes are drawn over the line ends. local half = BOX / 2 for id, p in pairs(pos) do local room = rooms[id] local x, y = screen(p) for _, d in ipairs(PLANAR) do local link = links[id] and links[id][d] if room.exits[d] or link then local dx, dy = DIRS[d].dx, DIRS[d].dy local x1, y1 = x + dx * half, y + dy * half local tp = link and pos[link.to] local x2, y2, colour local offX, offY = tp and (tp[1] - p[1] - dx), tp and (tp[2] - p[2] - dy) local boundaryMark = false if link and link.boundary then -- Into another sub-area, drawn on its own: a coloured stub with a -- dot at the end. x2, y2 = x + dx * (CELL * 0.3), y + dy * (CELL * 0.3) colour = BOUNDARY_COLOUR boundaryMark = true elseif tp and offX == 0 and offY == 0 then local tx, ty = screen(tp) x2, y2 = tx - dx * half, ty - dy * half colour = LINK_COLOUR elseif tp and IsIrregular(room.sx, room.sy) and math.abs(offX) <= 6 and math.abs(offY) <= 6 then -- Irregular square: rooms don't line up, so the exit is drawn -- all the way to wherever its room ended up, to the side of the -- room the way back leaves from. local tx, ty = screen(tp) local back = DIRS[DIRS[d].rev] x2, y2 = tx + back.dx * half, ty + back.dy * half colour = LINK_COLOUR else -- Unexplored, or leads somewhere that doesn't fit here: a stub. x2, y2 = x + dx * (CELL / 2 - 2), y + dy * (CELL / 2 - 2) colour = link and LINK_COLOUR or UNEXPLORED_COLOUR end local style = (link and link.hidden) and PEN_DOT or PEN_SOLID if link and link.hidden and not boundaryMark then colour = HIDDEN_COLOUR end local c1, c2, c3, c4 = clip(x1, y1, x2, y2) if c1 then WindowLine(win, math.floor(c1 + 0.5), math.floor(c2 + 0.5), math.floor(c3 + 0.5), math.floor(c4 + 0.5), colour, style, boundaryMark and 2 or 1) end if c1 and inside(x1, y1) and inside(x2, y2) then if boundaryMark then WindowRectOp(win, 2, x2 - 2, y2 - 2, x2 + 3, y2 + 3, BOUNDARY_COLOUR, 0) end local closed = room.doors[d] if closed ~= nil then -- A door, open or closed: a bar across the exit. local mx, my = math.floor((x1 + x2) / 2), math.floor((y1 + y2) / 2) WindowLine(win, mx - dy * 5, my + dx * 5, mx + dy * 5, my - dx * 5, DOOR_COLOUR, PEN_SOLID, 2) end end end end end
for id, p in pairs(pos) do local room = rooms[id] local x, y = screen(p) local l, t, r, b = x - half, y - half, x + half, y + half if inside(l, t) and inside(r, b) then local fill = room.dark and DARK_FILL or ROOM_FILL if id == current then fill = CURRENT_FILL end WindowRectOp(win, 2, l, t, r, b, fill, 0) WindowRectOp(win, 1, l, t, r, b, ROOM_BORDER, 0)
local linkU = links[id] and links[id].u local linkD = links[id] and links[id].d if room.exits.u or linkU then WindowPolygon(win, string.format("%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d", x - 4, y - 2, x + 4, y - 2, x, y - 7), UPDOWN_COLOUR, PEN_SOLID, 1, UPDOWN_COLOUR, 0, true, false) end if room.exits.d or linkD then WindowPolygon(win, string.format("%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d", x - 4, y + 2, x + 4, y + 2, x, y + 7), UPDOWN_COLOUR, PEN_SOLID, 1, UPDOWN_COLOUR, 0, true, false) end if room.noexits then -- A short wall on each side known to have no exit (dark rooms). for _, d in ipairs(PLANAR) do if room.noexits[d] then local dx, dy = DIRS[d].dx, DIRS[d].dy local mx, my = x + dx * (half + 3), y + dy * (half + 3) if dx ~= 0 and dy ~= 0 then WindowRectOp(win, 2, mx - 1, my - 1, mx + 2, my + 2, WALL_COLOUR, 0) else WindowLine(win, mx - dy * 6, my - dx * 6, mx + dy * 6, my + dx * 6, WALL_COLOUR, PEN_SOLID, 2) end end end end if HasSpecialExit(room) then WindowRectOp(win, 2, l + 2, b - 5, l + 5, b - 2, HIDDEN_COLOUR, 0) end if room.note then WindowRectOp(win, 2, r - 5, t + 2, r - 2, t + 5, NOTE_COLOUR, 0) end if showIds then local label = tostring(id) local tw = WindowTextWidth(win, ID_FONT_ID, label, false) or 0 WindowText(win, ID_FONT_ID, label, x - math.floor(tw / 2), b + 1, x + CELL, b + 12, ID_COLOUR, false) end end end
drawn = { pos = pos, cx = cx, cy = cy, areaTop = areaTop, areaBottom = areaBottom, specials = specialRects } end
local function AddHotspots(contentW, contentH) local button = ForgetButtonRect(contentW) WindowAddHotspot(mapWin.win, "amap_btn_forget", button.l, button.t, button.r, button.b, "", "", "AmapRoomMouseDown", "", "AmapForgetMenu", "Forget mapped rooms...", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
if not drawn then return end local win = mapWin.win for i, rect in ipairs(drawn.specials or {}) do WindowAddHotspot(win, "amap_special_" .. i, rect.l, rect.t, rect.r, rect.b, "", "", "AmapRoomMouseDown", "", "AmapSpecialClick", "Click to send: " .. rect.cmd, miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) end local top = mapWin:contentTop() -- Dragging the map's background pans it. Named to sort after every other -- hotspot (rooms, buttons, the window's own edges), so it never takes -- their clicks. local pb = math.min(drawn.areaBottom, top + contentH - EDGE_INSET) WindowAddHotspot(win, "zzz_amap_pan", EDGE_INSET, drawn.areaTop, contentW - EDGE_INSET, pb, "", "", "AmapPanDown", "", "", "", miniwin.cursor_both_arrow or 10, 0) WindowDragHandler(win, "zzz_amap_pan", "AmapPanMove", "AmapPanRelease", 0) local half = BOX / 2 for id, p in pairs(drawn.pos) do local room = rooms[id] if room then local x, y = drawn.cx + p[1] * CELL, drawn.cy + p[2] * CELL local l, t, r, b = x - half, y - half, x + half, y + half if l >= EDGE_INSET and r <= contentW - EDGE_INSET and t >= drawn.areaTop and b <= math.min(drawn.areaBottom, top + contentH - EDGE_INSET) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "amap_room_" .. id, l, t, r, b, "", "", "AmapRoomMouseDown", "", "AmapRoomMouseUp", RoomTooltip(room), miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) end end end end
local function PrintRoom(room) for line in RoomTooltip(room):gmatch("[^\n]+") do Note(line) end end
-- Clicking one of the listed unusual exits sends its command, as if typed. function AmapSpecialClick(flags, hotspotId) local i = tonumber(hotspotId:match("^amap_special_(%d+)$")) local rect = i and drawn and drawn.specials and drawn.specials[i] if rect then Execute(rect.cmd) end end
-- Panning: drag the background; the view re-centres when you move. function AmapPanDown(flags, hotspotId) if mapWin then mapWin:bringToFront() end -- 17/18 (mouse relative to the output window) at both ends: 14/15 are -- relative to this window, a different frame, and mixing them makes the -- view jump by the window's position on the first move. panStart = { WindowInfo(mapWin.win, 17), WindowInfo(mapWin.win, 18), panX, panY } end function AmapPanMove(flags, hotspotId) if not panStart then return end panX = panStart[3] + (WindowInfo(mapWin.win, 17) - panStart[1]) panY = panStart[4] + (WindowInfo(mapWin.win, 18) - panStart[2]) -- Not redraw(): that rebuilds hotspots, ending this drag. mapWin:repaintContent() end function AmapPanRelease(flags, hotspotId) panStart = nil RedrawMap() end
function AmapRoomMouseDown(flags, hotspotId) if mapWin then mapWin:bringToFront() end end
function AmapRoomMouseUp(flags, hotspotId) local id = tonumber(hotspotId:match("^amap_room_(%d+)$")) local room = id and rooms[id] if not room then return end
if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) == 0 then PrintRoom(room) return end
local x, y = WindowInfo(mapWin.win, 14), WindowInfo(mapWin.win, 15) local items = { room.note and "Edit note..." or "Add note..." } if room.note then items[#items + 1] = "Clear note" end items[#items + 1] = "-" items[#items + 1] = "Delete room" local choice = WindowMenu(mapWin.win, x, y, table.concat(items, "|")) or ""
if choice == "Add note..." or choice == "Edit note..." then local text = utils.inputbox("Note for " .. (room.name or ("room #" .. room.id)), "area_map", room.note or "") if text then text = Trim(text) room.note = (text ~= "") and text or nil SaveRoom(room) end elseif choice == "Clear note" then room.note = nil SaveRoom(room) elseif choice == "Delete room" then DeleteRoom(room.id) Note("deleted room #" .. id .. ".") else return end RedrawMap() end

-- Drops area rooms that no build since MIN_TRUSTED_BUILD has confirmed (see -- the comment at MIN_TRUSTED_BUILD), after copying the database to a backup. function PurgeUntrusted() local drop = {} for id, room in pairs(rooms) do if (room.build == nil or room.build < MIN_TRUSTED_BUILD) and not room.note and not IsOverland(room) then drop[#drop + 1] = id end end if #drop == 0 then return end
-- Back up first: write everything from the WAL into the main file, then -- copy that file byte for byte (works with any SQLite version). Nothing is -- removed if the backup can't be written. local backup = PluginDir() .. "area_map-before-" .. MIN_TRUSTED_BUILD .. ".db" local existing = io.open(backup, "rb") if existing then existing:close() else db:exec("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)") local src = io.open(PluginDir() .. "area_map.db", "rb") local data = src and src:read("*a") if src then src:close() end local dst = data and io.open(backup, "wb") if not dst then Note("couldn't back up area_map.db, so rooms from older builds were left as they are.") return end dst:write(data) dst:close() end
db:exec("BEGIN") for _, id in ipairs(drop) do DeleteRoom(id) end db:exec("COMMIT") Note("removed " .. #drop .. " area room(s) not confirmed since build " .. MIN_TRUSTED_BUILD .. " (mapping fixes since). Walk through to remap them; overland tiles and rooms with notes are kept. " .. "Backup: " .. backup) end
local function ShowStatus() local count, squares = 0, {} for _, room in pairs(rooms) do count = count + 1 squares[SquareLabel(room.sx, room.sy)] = true end local nSquares = 0 for _ in pairs(squares) do nSquares = nSquares + 1 end local confirmed = 0 for _, room in pairs(rooms) do if room.build == BUILD then confirmed = confirmed + 1 end end Note("build " .. BUILD .. ": " .. count .. " room(s) mapped in " .. nSquares .. " square(s), " .. confirmed .. " confirmed by this build.") Note(StatusText()) if not promptSpec then Note("prompt not known yet -- type wf_prompt_setup (mush_windows).") end end
local function ShowDebug() local d = lastDebug if not d then Note("nothing read yet this session.") return end Note("last command: " .. (d.cmd and ("'" .. d.cmd .. "'") or "(none)") .. " -> " .. tostring(d.kind) .. (d.key and (" '" .. d.key .. "'") or "") .. ", square " .. SquareLabel(d.sx, d.sy)) Note("output (" .. #d.lines .. " line(s), prompt removed):") for _, line in ipairs(d.lines) do Note(" | " .. line) end local obs = d.obs if obs then Note("read as " .. obs.mode .. " room:") if obs.name then Note(" name: " .. obs.name) end if obs.desc then Note(" desc: " .. obs.desc) end Note(" exits: " .. SetToString(obs.exits)) if next(obs.doors) then Note(" doors: " .. DoorsToString(obs.doors) .. " (c = closed, o = open)") end Note(" items: " .. #obs.items) end Note("decision: " .. (d.decision or "?")) if d.processMs then Note(string.format("took %.1f ms to read and save, %.1f ms to draw", d.processMs, d.drawMs or 0)) end end
-- Every room connected to startId by any exit, in either direction, without -- crossing overland tiles: the area you're standing in, across all its squares. local function AreaRoomIds(startId) local incoming = {} for fromId, cmds in pairs(links) do for _, link in pairs(cmds) do incoming[link.to] = incoming[link.to] or {} incoming[link.to][#incoming[link.to] + 1] = fromId end end local seen, ids = { [startId] = true }, { startId } local head = 1 while ids[head] do local id = ids[head] head = head + 1 local neighbours = {} for _, link in pairs(links[id] or {}) do neighbours[#neighbours + 1] = link.to end for _, fromId in ipairs(incoming[id] or {}) do neighbours[#neighbours + 1] = fromId end for _, other in ipairs(neighbours) do if rooms[other] and not seen[other] and not IsOverland(rooms[other]) then seen[other] = true ids[#ids + 1] = other end end end return ids end
-- Asks, then deletes the given rooms in one transaction. local function ForgetRooms(ids, what) if #ids == 0 then Note("no rooms to forget.") return end local squares, labels = {}, {} for _, id in ipairs(ids) do local label = SquareLabel(rooms[id].sx, rooms[id].sy) if not squares[label] then squares[label] = true labels[#labels + 1] = label end end table.sort(labels) local answer = utils.msgbox("Delete " .. #ids .. " room(s) -- " .. what .. " -- in square(s) " .. table.concat(labels, " ") .. "?", "area_map", "yesno", "?", 2) if answer ~= "yes" then return end db:exec("BEGIN") for _, id in ipairs(ids) do DeleteRoom(id) end db:exec("COMMIT") Note("deleted " .. #ids .. " room(s). Walk through again to remap.") RedrawMap() end
function AmapCommand(name, line, wildcards) local arg = Trim(wildcards[1] or ""):lower() if arg == "" then ShowStatus() elseif arg == "trace" or arg == "trace on" or arg == "trace off" then if arg == "trace" then traceOn = not traceOn else traceOn = (arg == "trace on") end SetVariable("trace", traceOn and "1" or "0") Note(traceOn and "trace on: a line per move, also saved in area_map.db (table 'trace')." or "trace off (moves are still saved in area_map.db, table 'trace').") elseif arg == "ids" then showIds = not showIds SetVariable("show_ids", showIds and "1" or "0") Note(showIds and "showing room numbers on the map." or "room numbers hidden.") RedrawMap() elseif arg == "debug" then ShowDebug() elseif arg == "boundary" or arg:match("^boundary ") then local room = current and rooms[current] if not room then Note("you're not in a known room.") return end local which = Trim(arg:sub(9)) if which == "" then local list = {} for cmd, link in pairs(links[room.id] or {}) do if link.boundary then list[#list + 1] = cmd end end table.sort(list) Note(#list == 0 and "no exit from this room is a sub-area boundary. 'amap boundary <exit>' marks one." or ("sub-area boundaries from this room: " .. table.concat(list, ", "))) return end local cmd = DIR_WORDS[which] or which local link = links[room.id] and links[room.id][cmd] if not link or not rooms[link.to] then Note("no known exit '" .. which .. "' from this room (walk through it first).") return end local on = not link.boundary link.boundary = on or nil SaveLink(room.id, cmd, link) -- The way back is the same boundary. for backCmd, back in pairs(links[link.to] or {}) do if back.to == room.id then back.boundary = on or nil SaveLink(link.to, backCmd, back) end end local to = rooms[link.to] Note("exit '" .. cmd .. "' to " .. (to.name or ("room #" .. to.id)) .. (on and " is now a sub-area boundary (both ways): each side is drawn on its own." or " is no longer a sub-area boundary.")) RedrawMap() elseif arg == "subarea" or arg:match("^subarea ") then local room = current and rooms[current] if not room then Note("you're not in a known room.") return end local name = Trim((wildcards[1] or ""):match("^%s*[Ss][Uu][Bb][Aa][Rr][Ee][Aa]%s*(.-)%s*$") or "") local list = SubAreaRooms(room.id) if name == "" then local current_name = SubAreaName(room.id) Note("you're in " .. (current_name and ("sub-area '" .. current_name .. "'") or "an unnamed part") .. " (" .. #list .. " room(s)). Mark the exits around a part with 'amap boundary <exit>', " .. "then name it with 'amap subarea <name>' ('amap subarea none' to clear).") return end for _, id in ipairs(list) do if rooms[id].subarea then rooms[id].subarea = nil SaveRoom(rooms[id]) end end if name:lower() ~= "none" then room.subarea = name SaveRoom(room) Note("named the " .. #list .. " room(s) you can reach from here without crossing a boundary: '" .. name .. "'.") else Note("name cleared for the " .. #list ..
